title: Customer Experience Score™
tagline: Are your clients delighted — or quietly drifting to competitors?
description: 12 questions that score response times, reviews, onboarding, communication and retention — and reveal your highest-priority experience improvements.

categories.label: Responsiveness
categories.recommendation: Set a visible response-time standard (e.g. 'we reply within 2 business hours') and hit it with auto-acknowledgements, shared inboxes and self-serve answers.

categories.label: Reviews & Feedback
categories.recommendation: Automate a review request within 48 hours of every completed job, and add one simple feedback question so problems reach you before they reach Google.

categories.label: Onboarding
categories.recommendation: Script the first 14 days of every new client relationship: welcome message, expectations, timeline and an early win. Automate the sends so it never gets skipped.

categories.label: Proactive Communication
categories.recommendation: Never make clients chase you for status. Automate progress updates at fixed milestones — silence is where trust dies.

categories.label: Retention & Loyalty
categories.recommendation: Build a simple stay-in-touch system: check-ins, anniversaries and helpful content. Retained clients cost 5x less than new ones.

questions.text: How quickly do clients get a reply when they reach out?

options.label: Fast, with instant acknowledgement + quick answers

questions.text: Can clients get answers to common questions without waiting for you?

options.label: No — every question needs a human
FAQ, portal or chatbot answers most things instantly

questions.text: Do client messages ever fall through the cracks?

options.label: Yes, regularly — and it causes problems
Never — every message is tracked to resolution
Automated request after every completed job

questions.text: Do you ask clients for feedback before problems become complaints?

options.label: No — we hear about problems too late

questions.text: How do you respond to the reviews you receive?

options.label: Every review gets a thoughtful, prompt response

questions.text: What does a new client experience in their first week?
Do new clients know exactly what happens next and when?

options.label: They often ask because we haven't told them
Clear timeline, expectations and milestones — in writing

questions.text: Do clients ever have to chase YOU for a status update?

options.label: Never — updates arrive before they ask

questions.text: How consistent is your communication quality across the team?

options.label: It depends entirely on who answers

questions.text: What happens after a job or engagement ends?

options.label: A deliberate stay-in-touch and reactivation system

questions.text: Do you know your client retention or repeat-purchase rate?

bands.label: At-Risk Experience
bands.summary: Slow replies, inconsistent onboarding and radio silence are quietly eroding trust — and in a referral-driven business, that compounds. The upside is huge: experience fixes are cheap, fast and immediately felt by every client you have.
actionPlan: Week 1: Set a response-time standard and add instant auto-acknowledgement to every channel.
Week 1: Write answers to your 10 most common client questions — publish them.
Week 2: Script a 14-day new-client welcome sequence and automate it.
Week 2: Set up automated review requests within 48 hours of job completion.
Week 3: Add automatic status updates at fixed project milestones.
Week 3: Create reply templates so quality doesn't depend on who answers.
Week 4: Call your 5 best clients and ask one question: 'What's one thing we could do better?'
Week 4: Book an AI Audit to automate the experience without losing the human touch.

bands.label: Good, Not Memorable
bands.summary: Your clients are satisfied — but satisfied clients don't refer, rave or stay the way delighted ones do. Closing the gaps in proactive communication and follow-through turns 'fine' into a growth engine.
actionPlan: Week 1: Fix your weakest category from the breakdown below first.
Week 1: Add auto-acknowledgement so no client ever wonders if you got their message.
Week 2: Upgrade onboarding: clear timeline, expectations and one early win.
Week 2: Automate review requests and respond to every review.
Week 3: Schedule proactive updates so clients never chase status.
Week 3: Add a quick mid-engagement feedback question to catch issues early.
Week 4: Launch a simple stay-in-touch rhythm for past clients.
Week 4: Book an AI Audit to systemize delight at scale.

bands.label: Delight Machine
bands.summary: Your client experience is a genuine competitive weapon — responsive, proactive and consistent. Now compound it: turn happy clients into an engine of reviews, referrals and repeat revenue, with AI handling the logistics.
actionPlan: Week 1: Launch or sharpen a referral program — your experience has earned it.
Week 1: Showcase your best reviews across website, proposals and social.
Week 2: Add AI-drafted personalization to check-ins and updates.
Week 2: Build a client health score to spot at-risk accounts early.
Week 3: Create surprise-and-delight moments at key milestones.
Week 3: Turn your best client stories into case studies (with permission).
Week 4: Review retention numbers and set next quarter's target.
Week 4: Book an AI Audit to scale the experience without adding headcount.
